title: norite overwrite --json
description:
The machine-readable output of `norite overwrite set` and `delete`.

Versioned source of truth (CLAUDE.md rule 15): a change to what these commands print ships with a change to this file in the same commit. The shapes are the CLI's, re-declared from the instance's rather than passed through. Every nullable field is present and null, every list is [] rather than null, and every string an instance sent is exactly as sent, with what a terminal would act on escaped as \uXXXX.

overwrite.description: One permission overwrite on a channel.

channel_id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

target_id.description: A Snowflake ID, as a decimal string.

allow.description: A permission bitfield as a decimal string: 63 bits do not survive a float64.

deny.description: A permission bitfield as a decimal string: 63 bits do not survive a float64.
